route: /style-board/ (the style board: module faq:two-column, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: The two-column FAQ still sets the heading in a narrow left column with one column of questions to its right, which squeezes 'Frequently Asked Questions' into three one-word lines on the longest sample (this was in the last review and is not fixed).
findings.reference: The competitor's FAQ (home 16) puts the eyebrow and heading across the full content width on one line. The closed questions sit below them in two side-by-side columns of hairline rows, each with a + at its right.
findings.fix: Give the faq two-column variant a stacked arrangement. The heading spans the top, starting on the content's left edge. Below it, .faq__items is a two-column grid of rows whose column count follows the question length, falling back to one column when the questions are too long for two.

findings.issue: On the shortest sample the questions still wrap at about 60% of the row ('…World Aquatics-approved for / competition…', '…front- / support panels…'), leaving a gap of roughly 350 px between each question's text and its +/− mark.
findings.reference: The competitor's questions run from the row's left edge up to just before the +, so each row reads as one line ending in its mark.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, remove any max-width / measure cap and text-wrap: balance from .block--faq:is([data-variant="two-column"], [data-variant="accordion"], [data-variant="open-list"]) .faq__item h3, so the question fills the summary up to its ::after mark.

findings.issue: The question list has rules only under each row, so the first question still has no line above it and the list's top edge is undefined next to the heading.
findings.reference: The competitor draws a hairline above the first row as well, so every question sits between two rules.
findings.fix: Add border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 18%, transparent) to .block--faq:is([data-variant="two-column"], [data-variant="accordion"], [data-variant="open-list"]) .faq__items, matching the rules between rows (reference.css line 305).

findings.issue: The open answer runs the full width of the list column, about 820 px or roughly 100 characters a line on the longest sample, so the long answer is hard to follow from line to line.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps its FAQ answers in a half-width column, well within a comfortable reading measure.
findings.fix: Cap the answer paragraph at a reading measure with max-width: 70ch on .block--faq:is([data-variant="two-column"], [data-variant="accordion"], [data-variant="open-list"]) .faq__item p. Leave the question's width alone so it still runs up to the mark.

findings.issue: On phones the questions still wrap well short of the column ('Can you show examples of swimwear / you've made for brands selling / in Europe or North America?'), leaving 50–70 px of each row empty and turning rows into three or four ragged lines.
findings.reference: The competitor's questions run the full row width up to the + mark.
findings.fix: Let .block--faq .faq__item h3 fill the summary width up to the mark on phones, with no max-width and no text-wrap: balance. Keep the 15px bold navy type.
